note: Fuzzer-controlled bytes are reinterpreted as the H3 cell index that drives the library calls.
The input cell determines whether the pentagon-specific path is taken while filling the output array.
The loop iterates over all six output slots, including the pentagon-only slot that is later left untouched by the bug.
The safety obligation is that every output element must be initialized before any later read; this branch skips writing the final slot for pentagons.
For non-pentagons this slot is written, but on the pentagon path the corresponding array element is not assigned and remains uninitialized for later use.
